returns.noticeTitle: A return currently adds cost to a job card instead of crediting it.
returns.noticeBody1: MRT is a material RETURN: the store taking parts back off a job. Every return line in this data is booked as a positive amount, which means the job card is charged for parts that came back to the shelf.
returns.noticeBody2: The value column below is exactly what the ledger holds, so this page agrees with Expenses and CPK. The credited column shows what the same returns would come to if a return credited the job. Which of those is correct for the books is an owner decision about money, not a display setting, so it is reported here rather than applied.

reorder.title: Suggested reorder levels
reorder.explain: Sized from each site's ERP issues over the last {months} months. Critical level covers the lead time (Material Master lead time when set, otherwise {days} days); min adds half a month of safety stock; reorder qty covers two months. Nothing changes until you select rows and apply them.

reorder.confirmBody: This writes min level, critical level and reorder qty on {count} stock row(s). Stock quantities are not changed. Each row can be edited back from the register.
